items.name: 离散模拟信号
items.definition: 控制器中的脉冲元件，其输人和输出为脉冲序列，即时间上离散而幅值上连续的信号，称为离散模拟信号。

items.name: Frequency Response
items.definition: Frequency Response：A linear system's response to sinusoidal inputs, obtained from knowledge of its pole and zero locations.
